verdict: Meta is delivering leads; Google spend and intake pipeline need attention now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 12 leads at an average cost of $195.79 per lead — and all 12 came from Meta, which spent $641.67 at $53.47 per lead. Google Ads consumed $1,707.77 over the same window and produced 7 conversions at roughly $244 per lead, 4.6 times the Meta cost, so Google spend is being pulled back while Meta budget holds steady. Lead volume is accelerating: the most recent three days produced 7 leads compared to 3 in the three days prior, a signal that Meta is gaining traction. One area we're watching closely is the intake pipeline — 59 opportunities have entered your system this period with no appointments recorded, which means leads are arriving but not yet converting to signed cases, and we're working through that with you now.
